recognize_zh: 切片中成片的漿細胞樣腫瘤細胞（偏心核、車輪狀染色質、部分有核仁），其間可見細長、均質嗜伊紅的針狀或棒狀結晶，有的位於細胞外，有的在細胞胞質內，符合漿細胞骨髓瘤合併免疫球蛋白結晶沉積。
features: Diffuse sheets of plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, moderate eosinophilic-amphophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear clearing
Nuclear atypia: coarse clock-face to vesicular chromatin, conspicuous nucleoli in some cells, occasional binucleation and mitotic figure
Large elongated, homogeneous, glassy eosinophilic rod-shaped crystal lying extracellularly between plasma cells
Smaller rhomboid/needle-shaped eosinophilic crystals within plasma cell cytoplasm
Minimal residual hematopoiesis or fat in these fields
describe_en: Sections show a diffuse, sheet-like infiltrate of atypical plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse to vesicular chromatin, occasional prominent nucleoli and mitotic figures. Interspersed are elongated, homogeneous, glassy eosinophilic crystals, some extracellular and others within the cytoplasm of neoplastic plasma cells. The crystals likely represent precipitated monoclonal immunoglobulin or light chain. Findings are consistent with plasma cell myeloma with extracellular and intracellular crystal deposition; light-chain immunostains and evaluation for light-chain–associated renal injury (e.g., crystalline nephropathy, Fanconi syndrome) are advised.

ddx.vs: In CSH the crystals accumulate within CD68-positive histiocytes rather than within plasma cells or free in the interstitium.
Charcot-Leyden crystals are bipyramidal, form in eosinophil-rich lesions and are not associated with sheets of clonal plasma cells.
Oxalate crystals are birefringent, pale and fan-shaped and urate crystals are needle-shaped in tophi, neither arising from plasma cells.
LPL shows a mixed small lymphocyte, plasmacytoid and plasma cell population with round globular inclusions rather than elongated crystals and sheets of atypical plasma cells.
